listing.name: NASCAR Rumble (Full Rumble)
listing.summary: A Windows port of NASCAR Rumble. Set it up with your own original PlayStation disc image.

steps.title: Prepare your Windows copy
steps.instruction: Use Windows x64 with OpenGL 4.5 support. Extract the Windows ZIP into a writable folder. Open FullRumble.exe and choose the disc image from your own USA or Canada PlayStation release (SLUS-01068). The setup accepts CUE/BIN, a supported standalone BIN, or ISO. Wait for the game to finish its local build before adding this copy to Portcove.

warnings: Keep your original disc image and the memory-card files. Use the game’s own updater outside a Portcove Play session, then review the changed program in Portcove.

data_locations: carda.sav, cardb.sav, settings.json and interface.ini in the working folder
%APPDATA%/FullRumble for setup settings and the generated library
disc/ beside the program, or %LOCALAPPDATA%/FullRumble/disc if the program folder is not writable
